def: A large box for shipping goods, or any object used to hold things.
用來運送貨物的大型貨櫃，或任何用來裝東西的容器。
ex: The shipping container arrived at the port on Monday morning.
那只運輸貨櫃週一早上抵達港口。
Please store the leftover paint in a sealed container.
請把剩下的油漆存放在密封容器裡。
Each container holds about twenty tons of cargo.
每只貨櫃可裝載約二十噸貨物。
Empty containers are stacked behind the loading area.
空貨櫃堆放在裝卸區後方。
Staff may bring their own food containers to the break room.
員工可以自備食物容器帶進休息室。

note: More formal; any object that holds something, usually smaller than a shipping container.
較正式；指任何用來盛裝東西的器具，通常比貨櫃小。
A carton is a cardboard box; a container can be made of any material.
carton 是紙箱；container 可以是任何材質的容器。

def: A person or company hired to do a specific job, such as building work.
受雇完成特定工作（如建築工程）的個人或公司。
ex: We hired a contractor to renovate the lobby.
我們聘請了一位承包商來整修大廳。
The contractor promised to finish the roof before the rainy season.
承包商承諾在雨季前完成屋頂。
All outside contractors must sign in at the front desk.
所有外來承包人員都必須在櫃檯登記。
She works as an independent contractor for several software firms.
她以獨立接案者的身分為數家軟體公司工作。
The general contractor manages the electricians and plumbers on site.
總承包商負責管理現場的電工和水管工。

note: Always an individual who sells services; a contractor can also be a whole company.
一定是個人接案；contractor 也可能是整間公司。
A contract is the written agreement; the contractor is the person or firm that signs it to do the work.
contract 是書面合約；contractor 是簽約承接工作的人或公司。

def: Needing a lot of money, or causing a serious loss.
需要花很多錢，或造成嚴重損失的。
ex: A product recall would be costly for the company.
產品召回會讓公司付出高昂的代價。
The delay proved costly because we missed the shipping window.
這次延誤代價慘重，因為我們錯過了出貨時段。
Replacing the old servers is too costly for this year's budget.
更換舊伺服器對今年的預算來說太貴了。
Skipping regular maintenance is a costly mistake.
略過定期維護是個代價高昂的錯誤。
Hiring and training new staff is more costly than keeping current employees.
聘用並訓練新員工比留住現有員工更花錢。

note: Only about a high price; costly can also stress a heavy loss or sacrifice.
只指價格高；costly 還可強調沉重的損失或犧牲。

def: A person or company that delivers documents and parcels quickly.
快速遞送文件與包裹的人或公司。
ex: The courier delivered the contract to our office before noon.
快遞員在中午前把合約送到了我們辦公室。
We sent the signed documents by courier so they would arrive overnight.
我們用快遞寄出簽好的文件，讓它們隔夜送達。
A motorcycle courier picked up the parcel at three o'clock.
一位機車快遞員在三點取走了包裹。
Please call the courier company to confirm the pickup time.
請打電話給快遞公司確認取件時間。
International couriers charge more for urgent deliveries.
國際快遞公司對急件收費較高。

note: A person who carries messages or small packages, usually within one city.
遞送訊息或小包裹的人，通常在同一城市內。
Usually a transport company that moves goods or mail, not one person.
通常指運送貨物或郵件的運輸公司，而非個人。

def: The latest date or time by which something must be finished or submitted.
事情必須完成或提交的最後日期或時間。
ex: The deadline for the proposal is next Friday at noon.
提案的截止時間是下週五中午。
We missed the deadline because the client changed the specifications.
因為客戶更改規格，我們錯過了期限。
Can you extend the deadline by two days?
你可以把期限延長兩天嗎？
She is working under a tight deadline this week.
她這週在很緊的期限下工作。
All applications must reach us before the deadline of June 30.
所有申請都必須在 6 月 30 日截止前送達。

note: Plainer; the date a payment or task is due, often printed on a bill or form.
較平實；款項或工作到期的日子，常印在帳單或表格上。
The final point after which nothing is accepted, such as for orders or applications.
超過就不再受理的最後時點，如訂單或申請。
A timeline is the planned order of steps over time; a deadline is the final date.
timeline 是依時間排列的計畫步驟；deadline 是最後期限。

def: To take an amount of money or points away from a total.
從總額中減去一筆金額或分數。
ex: The company will deduct the fee from your final payment.
公司會從你最後一筆付款中扣除這筆費用。
Taxes are deducted from your salary each month.
稅金每個月從你的薪水中扣除。
You can deduct travel expenses from your taxable income.
你可以從應稅所得中扣除差旅費用。
Points will be deducted for late submissions.
逾期繳交會被扣分。
The hotel deducted the deposit from the total bill.
飯店從總帳單中扣掉了訂金。
coll: 從 B 中扣除 A

note: Used in maths for numbers; deduct is more common for money, tax and points.
多用於數學中的數字；deduct 較常用於金錢、稅金和分數。
To hold back part of a payment, such as tax, before paying the rest.
在付款前先扣留一部分（如稅金）再付其餘部分。
Deduce means to reach a conclusion by reasoning; it has nothing to do with money.
deduce 是經由推理得出結論，與金錢無關。

def: A doctor who treats problems of the teeth and gums.
治療牙齒與牙齦問題的醫師。
ex: I have an appointment with the dentist at nine tomorrow.
我明天九點要看牙醫。
Our company insurance covers a visit to the dentist twice a year.
公司保險涵蓋每年兩次的牙醫看診。
The dentist recommended a cleaning every six months.
牙醫建議每六個月洗一次牙。
She left work early to see her dentist.
她提早下班去看她的牙醫。
A dentist in the next building offers evening appointments.
隔壁大樓有一位牙醫提供晚上的門診。

def: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.
離開某地的行為，尤指旅程的開始。
ex: The departure of Flight 204 has been delayed by one hour.
204 號班機的起飛延誤了一小時。
Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
請在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。
Her departure from the firm surprised many colleagues.
她離開公司讓許多同事感到意外。
Check the departure board for your gate number.
請查看出發看板確認你的登機門號碼。
The new design is a major departure from our earlier products.
這個新設計與我們先前的產品大不相同。

note: Leaving a room, building or position; departure usually refers to a journey or a job.
指離開房間、建築或職位；departure 多指旅程或離職。
A department is a section of an organization; departure is the act of leaving.
department 是組織中的部門；departure 是離開的動作。

def: Able to be trusted to do what is expected, every time.
能讓人信任、每次都做到預期事項的。
ex: Mr. Lee is a dependable supplier who always delivers on time.
李先生是個可靠的供應商，總是準時交貨。
We need a dependable car for the long sales trips.
我們需要一輛可靠的車來跑長途業務行程。
The company is looking for dependable staff to work weekends.
公司正在尋找可靠的人員來上週末班。
A dependable internet connection is essential for remote work.
穩定可靠的網路連線對遠距工作不可或缺。
She has proved herself a dependable team leader.
她已證明自己是個值得信賴的組長。

note: Almost identical and more common; also used for machines, data and information.
意思幾乎相同且更常用；也可用於機器、資料和資訊。
Stresses honesty and character rather than steady performance.
強調誠實與品格，而非表現穩定。
Dependent means relying on someone; dependable means others can rely on you.
dependent 是依賴別人；dependable 是別人可以依賴你。

def: A sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal.
餐末食用的甜味餐點。
ex: We ordered cheesecake for dessert after the client dinner.
客戶晚宴後，我們點了起司蛋糕當甜點。
The restaurant's dessert menu changes every season.
這家餐廳的甜點菜單每季更換。
Lunch includes a main dish, a salad and dessert.
午餐包含主餐、沙拉和甜點。
Would you care for some dessert, or just coffee?
要不要來點甜點，還是只喝咖啡就好？
Several guests skipped dessert because they had a morning flight.
幾位賓客因為隔天一早要搭機而沒有吃甜點。

note: British; the sweet course of a meal, even when it is not actually a pudding.
英式用法；指餐末的甜點那一道，不一定真的是布丁。
A desert is dry land (also to abandon); dessert has a double s, as in sweet.
desert 是沙漠（也有拋棄之意）；dessert 有兩個 s，指甜食。

def: The sad feeling when something is not as good as you hoped.
事情不如預期時的難過感受。
ex: It was a great disappointment when the contract went to a rival.
合約被競爭對手拿走，令人非常失望。
To her disappointment, the seminar was cancelled.
令她失望的是，研討會被取消了。
The sales results were a disappointment to the whole team.
這份業績讓整個團隊都很失望。
He expressed disappointment at the slow service.
他對緩慢的服務表示失望。
Customers voiced their disappointment about the late delivery.
顧客對延遲送貨表達了失望。

note: Informal; mostly a disappointing event or thing, not the feeling itself.
口語；多指令人失望的事件或事物，而非感受本身。
-ing describes what causes the feeling; -ed describes the person who feels it.
-ing 形容造成感受的事物；-ed 形容有此感受的人。

def: A difference between two things that should be the same.
兩件本應一致的事物之間的差異。
ex: We found a discrepancy between the invoice and the delivery note.
我們發現發票和送貨單之間有出入。
The auditor asked about the discrepancy in last month's figures.
稽核員詢問上個月數字的出入。
Please report any discrepancies to the finance department.
如有任何差異請向財務部回報。
There is a large discrepancy between the two sales forecasts.
這兩份銷售預測之間有很大的落差。
The discrepancy arose from a data entry error.
這個差異是由資料輸入錯誤造成的。
coll: a discrepancy between A and B
A 與 B 之間的差異

note: A general lack of agreement; discrepancy is more often used for figures and records.
泛指不一致；discrepancy 較常用於數字與紀錄。
An accounting term for the gap between planned and actual amounts.
會計用語，指預算與實際金額之間的差距。
A difference that is often unfair or large, such as a pay disparity between groups.
常指不公平或懸殊的差距，例如不同群體間的薪資差距。

def: The delivery of goods to shops or customers, or the sharing out of something.
將貨物送到商店或顧客手上，或把某物分配出去。
ex: The distribution of the new product begins in March.
新產品的配銷將在三月開始。
We signed a distribution agreement with a regional wholesaler.
我們與一家區域批發商簽了經銷協議。
The warehouse manages distribution to all our retail stores.
這間倉庫負責配送到我們所有的零售門市。
The unequal distribution of work caused complaints among the staff.
工作分配不均引起了員工的抱怨。
The distribution of the annual report is scheduled for next week.
年報的發送排定在下週。

note: Bringing goods to one place; distribution is the wider system of reaching many outlets.
把貨物送到某處；distribution 指送達許多通路的整體體系。
Deciding who gets how much of a limited resource, such as budget or staff.
決定有限資源（如預算或人力）各分得多少。
A contribution is something given to a shared goal, such as money or effort.
contribution 是為共同目標付出的東西，如金錢或心力。

def: A share of a company's profit paid to its shareholders.
公司把部分獲利發給股東的款項。
ex: The board announced a quarterly dividend of fifty cents per share.
董事會宣布每股五十美分的季度股利。
Shareholders will receive their dividend payment in May.
股東將在五月收到股利。
The company cut its dividend after a weak year.
公司在業績不佳的一年後調降了股利。
Investing in staff training pays dividends in the long run.
投資員工訓練長期而言會有回報。
Some retirees rely on dividend income from their stocks.
有些退休人士靠持股的股利收入過活。

note: Any sum paid out, such as insurance or winnings; dividend is only a company's profit share.
任何付出的款項，如保險金或獎金；dividend 僅指公司的盈餘分配。
Interest is money earned on savings or charged on loans; a dividend comes from company profit.
interest 是存款賺得或貸款付出的利息；dividend 來自公司獲利。

zh: 碼頭、裝卸平台；靠岸；扣（薪）
def: A place where ships load and unload; also, to arrive at one or to cut part of someone's pay.
船隻裝卸貨物的地方；也指船隻靠岸，或扣減某人的部分薪水。
ex: The ship will dock at Pier 5 early tomorrow morning.
這艘船明天清晨會在五號碼頭靠岸。
Trucks wait at the loading dock to collect the pallets.
卡車在裝卸平台等著領取棧板。
Our boat is tied up at the dock behind the hotel.
我們的船繫泊在飯店後方的碼頭。
The firm will dock your pay if you arrive late without notice.
若你遲到又沒通知，公司會扣你的薪水。
She placed the tablet in its charging dock.
她把平板放進充電座。

note: A platform built out into the water; dock can also mean the loading area itself.
向水面延伸的平台；dock 也可指裝卸區本身。
The deck is the floor of a ship; the dock is where the ship ties up.
deck 是船上的甲板；dock 是船停靠的地方。

def: To give money, goods or time to help a person or cause.
為幫助某人或某項公益而給予金錢、物品或時間。
ex: Our firm will donate ten percent of this month's profits to the hospital.
本公司將把本月利潤的百分之十捐給醫院。
Several employees donated blood during the company health day.
公司健康日當天有幾位員工捐了血。
She donated her old laptop to a local school.
她把舊筆電捐給了當地一所學校。
The bakery donates unsold bread to a food bank every evening.
這家麵包店每天傍晚把賣剩的麵包捐給食物銀行。
Visitors are asked to donate to the museum's restoration fund.
博物館請訪客捐款支持修復基金。

note: Giving money or effort toward a shared aim; donate suggests charity.
為共同目標出錢出力；donate 帶有慈善性質。

def: To copy a file from the internet or a server to your own device.
把檔案從網路或伺服器複製到自己的裝置上。
ex: You can download the user manual from our website.
你可以從我們的網站下載使用手冊。
The download took several minutes on the hotel's slow Wi-Fi.
在飯店緩慢的無線網路上，這次下載花了好幾分鐘。
Please download the attached form and fill it in.
請下載附件中的表格並填寫。
Customers can download the app free of charge.
顧客可以免費下載這個應用程式。
The files are available for download after you log in.
登入後即可下載這些檔案。

note: Download copies a file to your device; install sets up a program so it can run.
download 是把檔案複製到裝置；install 是安裝程式使其可執行。

def: On or to a lower floor of a building.
在建築物較低的樓層，或往較低的樓層。
ex: The meeting room is downstairs, next to the reception desk.
會議室在樓下，就在接待櫃檯旁邊。
Please take the boxes downstairs to the mailroom.
請把這些箱子搬到樓下的收發室。
The downstairs office has a view of the garden.
樓下的辦公室看得到花園。
Our guests are waiting downstairs in the lobby.
我們的客人正在樓下大廳等候。
She ran downstairs to catch the courier before he left.
她跑下樓，趁快遞員離開前攔住他。

note: Downtown is the center of a city; downstairs is a lower floor of a building.
downtown 指市中心；downstairs 指建築物的較低樓層。

def: In or toward the main business area of a city.
在城市的主要商業區，或前往該區。
ex: Our head office is in downtown Chicago.
我們的總公司位於芝加哥市中心。
I am meeting a client downtown at two o'clock.
我兩點要到市中心見一位客戶。
Parking in the downtown area is expensive.
市中心一帶的停車費很貴。
Several new hotels have opened downtown this year.
今年市中心開了好幾間新飯店。
A shuttle bus runs from the airport to downtown every twenty minutes.
接駁巴士每二十分鐘從機場開往市中心。

note: The usual British term; downtown is mainly American English.
英式英語的慣用說法；downtown 主要是美式英語。
Downstairs is a lower floor of a building; downtown is the city center.
downstairs 是建築物的較低樓層；downtown 是市中心。

zh: 鑽孔機；演習、反覆訓練；鑽孔
def: A tool for making holes, or a repeated exercise to practice a procedure.
用來鑽孔的工具，或為熟練某程序而反覆進行的練習。
ex: The electrician used a power drill to make holes in the wall.
電工用電鑽在牆上鑽洞。
Staff will take part in a fire drill at ten o'clock.
員工將在十點參加消防演習。
The trainer drilled new staff on safety procedures before the launch.
開幕前，訓練師反覆演練新進員工的安全程序。
Engineers will drill a test well near the site next month.
工程師下個月將在工地附近鑽一口試驗井。
The course ends with a short drill on handling customer complaints.
課程最後有一段處理客訴的簡短演練。

note: A planned activity to practice a skill; a drill is shorter and more repetitive.
為練習技能而規劃的活動；drill 較短且更重複。

def: An exact copy of something, or to make an exact copy.
某物的完全相同複本，或指製作完全相同的複本。
ex: Please do not duplicate this report without permission.
未經許可請勿複製這份報告。
I received a duplicate invoice by mistake.
我誤收到一張重複的發票。
The system removes duplicate entries from the customer list.
系統會從客戶名單中移除重複的項目。
Keep a duplicate of the signed contract in your files.
請把簽署後合約的副本留在你的檔案中。
We should avoid duplicating work already done by the sales team.
我們應避免重複業務團隊已完成的工作。

note: The plain everyday word; duplicate suggests an exact copy.
日常用語；duplicate 強調與原件完全相同。
More formal or technical, often used for experiments, results and software.
較正式或偏技術，常用於實驗、結果與軟體。

def: A machine that carries people or goods up and down between floors.
在樓層之間載運人或貨物上下的機器。
ex: Take the elevator to the fifth floor and turn left.
搭電梯到五樓後左轉。
The elevator is out of order, so please use the stairs.
電梯故障了，請走樓梯。
A technician inspects the elevator every month.
技師每個月檢查一次電梯。
He rehearsed a thirty-second elevator pitch for the investors.
他為投資人演練了一段三十秒的電梯簡報。
Deliveries must use the service elevator at the rear of the building.
送貨必須使用大樓後方的貨梯。

note: The British word for the same machine; elevator is American.
同一種機器的英式說法；elevator 為美式。
An escalator is a moving staircase; an elevator is an enclosed lift.
escalator 是電扶梯；elevator 是封閉式電梯。

def: To put something in an envelope or package with a letter; also, to surround.
把東西與信件一起放入信封或包裹；也指圍住。
ex: Please enclose a copy of your résumé with the application.
請在申請文件中附上一份你的履歷。
I have enclosed the receipt for your records.
我已附上收據供您存查。
A cheque for the full amount is enclosed.
隨函附上全額支票。
The yard is enclosed by a high fence.
庭院被一道高圍籬圍住。
Please enclose a stamped, self-addressed envelope with your request.
請隨申請附上貼好郵票、寫好回郵地址的信封。
coll: 把 A 隨 B 附上

note: Used for email files or papers clipped together; enclose suits paper sent inside an envelope.
用於電子郵件檔案或夾在一起的紙本；enclose 適用於放進信封內的紙本。
Disclose means to reveal information, not to put something inside.
disclose 是揭露資訊，不是把東西放進去。

def: To come to the end of the time when something is valid.
到達某事物有效期限的終點。
ex: Your membership will expire at the end of the month.
你的會員資格將在月底到期。
The warranty expired last week, so repairs are no longer free.
保固上週到期了，所以維修不再免費。
Check that your passport has not expired before booking.
訂位前請確認你的護照沒有過期。
This coupon expires on December 31.
這張優待券在 12 月 31 日到期。
The lease will expire next spring, so we may move to a larger office.
租約明年春天到期，所以我們可能搬到更大的辦公室。

note: To stop being valid, often because it was not renewed in time.
因未及時續期而失效。
Informal; also used when a supply is used up, not only for dates.
口語；也可指供應用完，不限於期限。

def: Cloth made by weaving or knitting threads, used for clothes and furniture.
由線織成的布料，用於衣服和家具。
ex: The jacket is made from a lightweight fabric that dries quickly.
這件外套用輕薄、快乾的布料製成。
We ordered cotton fabric from a supplier in Vietnam.
我們向一家越南供應商訂購了棉布。
Samples of each fabric are available in the showroom.
每種布料的樣品都放在展示間。
The sofa's fabric is stain resistant and easy to clean.
這張沙發的布料防污又好清潔。
Trust between colleagues is part of the fabric of this company.
同事之間的信任是這間公司根基的一部分。

note: The everyday word; can also mean a single piece, such as a cleaning cloth.
日常用語；也可指單件，如抹布。
More technical or industrial; used for woven goods in manufacturing and trade.
較偏技術或工業；用於製造與貿易中的織品。

def: To make yourself or someone else well informed about something.
使自己或他人對某事物充分了解。
ex: New hires will spend a day familiarizing themselves with our software.
新進員工會花一天時間熟悉我們的軟體。
The manual helps drivers familiarize themselves with the safety rules.
這份手冊協助駕駛熟悉安全規定。
A short tour will familiarize visitors with the building layout.
一趟簡短的導覽會讓訪客熟悉大樓的配置。
Please familiarize yourself with the refund policy before taking calls.
接聽電話前，請先熟悉退款政策。
The workshop is designed to familiarize staff with the new accounting system.
這場工作坊旨在讓員工熟悉新的會計系統。

note: More formal; usually used as acquaint yourself with something.
較正式；通常用 acquaint yourself with 的形式。
Familiar describes what you already know; familiarize is the action of getting to know it.
familiar 描述已經熟悉的狀態；familiarize 是變得熟悉的動作。

def: Comments about work or a product, given to help it improve.
針對工作或產品所提出、用來協助改進的意見。
ex: We value your feedback on the new website design.
我們重視您對新網站設計的意見。
The manager gave her positive feedback after the presentation.
簡報結束後，經理給了她正面的回饋。
Customer feedback helped us improve the packaging.
顧客的回饋幫助我們改進了包裝。
Please send any feedback to the survey team by Friday.
請在週五前把任何意見寄給問卷小組。
Employees receive feedback on their performance twice a year.
員工每年會收到兩次績效回饋。

note: Can be a single remark; feedback is uncountable and aims at improvement.
可以是單句評語；feedback 為不可數名詞，目的在於改進。
Ideas or information contributed to help a decision; less about judging past work.
為協助決策而提供的想法或資訊；較不是在評價過去的表現。
A review is a formal assessment or a public opinion of a product; feedback is for improving.
review 是正式評估或對商品的公開評價；feedback 是為了改進。

def: A group of vehicles, ships or aircraft owned or run by one organization.
同一機構擁有或營運的一批車輛、船隻或飛機。
ex: The company operates a fleet of fifty delivery vans.
這家公司經營一支由五十輛送貨車組成的車隊。
Our airline is adding six aircraft to its fleet.
我們的航空公司正為機隊增加六架飛機。
The rental agency renews its fleet every three years.
租車公司每三年更新一次車隊。
A fleet manager schedules the vehicle maintenance.
車隊經理負責安排車輛保養。
All fleet vehicles must carry a first-aid kit.
所有公司車輛都必須配備急救箱。

def: A cardboard cover for loose papers, or a place on a computer that holds files.
用來裝散頁紙張的硬紙夾，或電腦中存放檔案的位置。
ex: Save the final report in the shared folder.
把最終報告存到共用資料夾。
She keeps all invoices in a blue folder on her desk.
她把所有發票放在桌上的一個藍色文件夾裡。
I created a new folder for the project files.
我為專案檔案建了一個新資料夾。
Delegates received a folder containing the agenda and a name badge.
與會代表拿到一份文件夾，內有議程和名牌。
Move the old emails into an archive folder to free up space.
把舊郵件移到封存資料夾以釋出空間。

note: The older computing term for a folder on a drive; folder is the everyday word.
電腦中資料夾的較舊說法；folder 是日常用語。
A file is a single document; a folder holds several files.
file 是單一文件；folder 可裝多個檔案。

def: To order that something must not be done.
下令某事不得進行。
ex: Company policy forbids employees from accepting expensive gifts.
公司政策禁止員工收受貴重禮品。
The contract forbids us to share the data with third parties.
合約禁止我們與第三方分享這些資料。
Smoking is strictly forbidden in all areas of the building.
大樓內所有區域嚴禁吸菸。
Visitors are forbidden to take photographs in the laboratory.
訪客不得在實驗室內拍照。
The law forbids the sale of these products to minors.
法律禁止將這些產品賣給未成年人。

note: More formal; typical in laws and regulations, usually followed by from doing.
較正式；常見於法律和規定中，多接 from doing。
An official, often public decision to stop something for a whole group.
對整個群體正式、常為公開的禁止。

def: In an official way, or in a serious style that follows rules.
以官方的方式，或以遵循規範的嚴肅方式。
ex: The new director will be formally introduced at Monday's meeting.
新任主管將在週一的會議上正式介紹。
Please dress formally for the awards dinner.
出席頒獎晚宴請穿著正式服裝。
Complaints must be submitted formally in writing.
投訴必須以書面正式提出。
The two companies formally announced their merger on Tuesday.
兩家公司在週二正式宣布合併。
She was formally offered the position yesterday.
她昨天正式獲得了這個職位的聘用。

note: Stresses that it comes from an authority; formally can also mean in a formal style.
強調出自官方；formally 也可指以正式的方式。
Formerly means in the past; formally means in an official or formal way.
formerly 指以前；formally 指正式地。

def: A place or event where people can discuss a topic and share views.
讓人討論某個主題並交流看法的地方或活動。
ex: The company hosts an online forum where customers share tips.
公司設有一個線上論壇，讓顧客分享使用心得。
She will speak at an industry forum in Singapore next month.
她下個月將在新加坡的一場產業論壇上發言。
The staff forum gives employees a place to raise concerns.
員工論壇讓員工有地方提出疑慮。
Post your question on the support forum and an expert will reply.
把你的問題貼在支援論壇上，會有專家回覆。
The economic forum brought together leaders from twenty countries.
這場經濟論壇聚集了來自二十個國家的領袖。

note: An online page for posts and replies; a forum can also be a live event.
可張貼與回覆的網頁；forum 也可以是現場活動。
A formal meeting where experts present papers on one subject.
專家針對單一主題發表論文的正式會議。

zh: 加盟店；特許經營權；授權加盟
def: A right to sell a company's products under its name, or a business that does so.
以某公司名義銷售其產品的權利，或採用此方式經營的店。
ex: She bought a coffee shop franchise in the city center.
她在市中心買下了一家咖啡店的加盟權。
The company plans to franchise its restaurants across Asia.
這家公司打算在亞洲各地開放餐廳加盟。
The franchise owner pays a monthly fee to the parent company.
加盟店主每月要付一筆費用給總公司。
The franchise agreement runs for ten years and can be renewed.
這份加盟合約為期十年，可以續約。
The chain has over three hundred franchises nationwide.
這個連鎖品牌在全國有三百多家加盟店。

note: Permission to use a name or product; a franchise also includes a whole business system.
使用名稱或產品的許可；franchise 還包含整套經營模式。
A chain is a group of shops under one brand; its shops may be owned by the company or by franchisees.
chain 是同一品牌的一群店；店面可能由公司自營或由加盟者經營。

def: Goods carried by ship, train, truck or plane, or the cost of carrying them.
以船、火車、卡車或飛機運送的貨物，或運送它們的費用。
ex: The freight will arrive at the port on Thursday.
這批貨將在週四抵達港口。
Air freight is faster but more expensive than sea freight.
空運比海運快，但費用更高。
Freight charges are not included in the quoted price.
報價中不含運費。
A freight train carrying coal passed through the town.
一列載煤的貨運火車穿過了小鎮。
We use a freight forwarder to arrange the customs paperwork.
我們委託貨運承攬業者處理報關文件。

note: The goods carried by a ship or plane; it does not mean the shipping cost.
船或飛機載運的貨物；不指運費。
One specific batch of goods sent together; freight is goods in transport in general.
一次一起寄送的特定批貨物；freight 泛指運輸中的貨物。

def: A building for parking cars, or a place where cars are repaired.
停放汽車的建築物，或修理汽車的地方。
ex: Our delivery vans are parked in the garage overnight.
我們的送貨車夜間停放在車庫。
Visitors may use the underground garage beneath the office tower.
訪客可使用辦公大樓下方的地下停車場。
The car is at the garage for a brake check.
那輛車正在修車廠做煞車檢查。
The start-up began in a friend's garage with two employees.
這家新創公司起初是在朋友的車庫裡，只有兩名員工。
The hotel charges guests ten dollars a night to park in its garage.
這間飯店向住客收取每晚十美元的車庫停車費。
coll: take the car to the garage

note: British; any area or building for parking, while a garage is always a covered building or workshop.
英式；泛指停車的區域或建築，garage 則一定是有遮蔽的建築或修車廠。

def: The completion of a course of study, or the ceremony that marks it.
完成一段學業，或為此舉行的典禮。
ex: Her graduation is in June, and she is already looking for jobs.
她六月畢業，已經在找工作了。
Applicants should have a degree and two years of experience after graduation.
應徵者須具備學位，以及畢業後兩年的經驗。
He joined the firm right after graduation and was promoted within two years.
他一畢業就進了這家公司，兩年內就獲得晉升。
The graduation ceremony will be held in the main hall.
畢業典禮將在大禮堂舉行。
Interns receive a certificate upon graduation from the training program.
實習生在結業時會獲頒證書。

family.zh: 畢業（同形名詞指畢業生）

def: Relating to pictures and design, or a picture or chart used to show information.
與圖片和設計有關，或指用來呈現資訊的圖片或圖表。
ex: Our graphic designer is preparing the cover of the brochure.
我們的平面設計師正在製作手冊的封面。
The report includes a graphic showing sales growth by region.
報告中有一張圖表呈現各地區的銷售成長。
Use graphics to make the presentation easier to follow.
用圖像讓簡報更容易理解。
The warning label carries a clear graphic of a falling object.
警告標籤上有一個清楚的落物圖示。
This computer is powerful enough for graphic design work.
這台電腦的效能足以應付平面設計工作。

note: As a noun, any picture, chart or video used to show something; graphic is usually a drawn image.
作名詞時指用來呈現內容的圖片、圖表或影片；graphic 通常指繪製的圖像。
A graph is a diagram of numbers or data; a graphic is any picture or design.
graph 是呈現數字或資料的圖；graphic 是任何圖像或設計。

def: The physical parts of a computer, or tools and metal goods for the home.
電腦的實體零件，或家用工具和金屬製品。
ex: The store sells tools, paint and other hardware.
這間店販售工具、油漆和其他五金用品。
We need to upgrade our computer hardware before installing the software.
安裝這套軟體前，我們需要升級電腦硬體。
She works at a hardware store on Main Street.
她在大街上的一家五金行工作。
A hardware failure caused the network to go down for an hour.
硬體故障讓網路中斷了一小時。
The firm designs both hardware and software for smart home devices.
這家公司同時設計智慧家電的硬體與軟體。

note: Any tools or machines needed for a job; hardware is narrower, for computers or metal goods.
工作所需的任何工具或機器；hardware 較窄，指電腦設備或金屬製品。

def: A hard covering worn on the head to protect it from injury.
戴在頭上、保護頭部免於受傷的硬質護具。
ex: All visitors to the site must wear a helmet.
所有進入工地的訪客都必須戴安全帽。
The cyclist put on a helmet before leaving the office.
那位騎自行車的人離開辦公室前戴上了安全帽。
Safety helmets are provided at the entrance to the factory.
工廠入口處提供安全帽。
The company supplies each rider with a helmet and a reflective vest.
公司為每位騎士提供一頂安全帽和一件反光背心。
Replace your helmet if it has been damaged in a fall.
如果安全帽在跌落時受損，請更換。

note: A helmet worn by construction and factory workers; helmet also covers cycling and motorcycle gear.
建築和工廠工人戴的安全帽；helmet 也包括騎車用的頭盔。

def: A main road that connects towns or cities and carries fast traffic.
連接城鎮或城市、車流快速的主要道路。
ex: The factory is located near the main highway.
工廠位在主要公路附近。
Traffic on the highway was slow because of an accident.
公路上的車流因事故而緩慢。
The government plans to build a new highway between the two cities.
政府計畫在兩座城市之間興建新的公路。
Take Exit 12 off the highway and follow the signs.
從高速公路的 12 號出口下去，再沿著指標走。
Our trucks use the highway to reach the port in two hours.
我們的卡車走公路，兩小時內就能抵達港口。

note: American; a highway with several lanes and no crossings or traffic lights, so a freeway is one kind of highway.
美式；多線道、沒有平交路口或紅綠燈的公路，所以 freeway 是 highway 的一種。
A fast road with limited entrances and exits, often in cities.
出入口受限的快速道路，常見於都市。
The British word for a major road built for fast long-distance traffic.
英式說法，指專供長途快速行駛的主要道路。

def: To become responsible for a cost, debt or penalty because of your actions.
因自己的行為而須承擔某項費用、債務或罰款。
ex: The company incurred heavy losses after the product recall.
產品召回後，公司承受了嚴重的損失。
You may incur extra charges if you cancel within 24 hours.
若在 24 小時內取消，你可能會產生額外費用。
Employees will be reimbursed for expenses incurred during business trips.
員工出差期間所產生的費用將獲得報銷。
Late payments may incur a penalty of two percent.
逾期付款可能會被罰百分之二的違約金。
The project incurred extra labor costs because of bad weather.
專案因天氣不佳而產生額外的人力成本。

note: Informal; to let a bill or debt grow quickly, as in run up a debt.
口語；讓帳單或債務快速增加，如 run up a debt。
Formal; to suffer damage or a loss, used for injuries and losses rather than fees.
正式；遭受損害或損失，多用於傷害和損失，而非費用。
Occur means to happen; incur means to bring a cost or problem upon yourself.
occur 是發生；incur 是使自己承擔費用或麻煩。

def: To look at something closely to check its condition or quality.
仔細查看某物，以確認其狀況或品質。
ex: Officers will inspect the factory before issuing the certificate.
官員將在核發證書前視察工廠。
Please inspect the goods carefully when they arrive.
貨物送達時，請仔細檢查。
The mechanic inspected the engine and found a leak.
技師檢查引擎後發現有漏油。
Customs officers inspected every container at the port.
海關人員檢查了港口的每一只貨櫃。
Managers regularly inspect the kitchen for cleanliness.
主管定期檢查廚房的清潔狀況。

note: To look closely and in detail; also used for medical checks and tests.
仔細詳細地查看；也用於醫療檢查和測試。
Everyday and quick; inspect is more formal and thorough.
日常用語且較快速；inspect 較正式、較徹底。
Inspire means to motivate or give someone an idea; it has nothing to do with checking.
inspire 是激勵或啟發；與檢查無關。

def: An official or careful check of something to see that it meets standards.
為確認是否符合標準而進行的正式或仔細檢查。
ex: The building passed its annual fire safety inspection.
這棟大樓通過了年度消防安全檢查。
An inspection of the shipment revealed several damaged items.
對這批貨的檢驗發現有幾件受損。
Home buyers often pay for an inspection before signing the contract.
購屋者常在簽約前付費請人驗屋。
The records are available for inspection at the head office.
紀錄可在總公司供查閱。
Upon closer inspection, the report contained several errors.
仔細檢查後發現，這份報告有幾處錯誤。

note: A quicker, more informal look; inspection is formal and often official.
較快速、較不正式的查看；inspection 較正式，常是官方的。
An official check of accounts or processes, usually of finances; inspection covers physical items.
對帳目或流程的正式查核，多為財務方面；inspection 則涵蓋實物。

def: A person whose job is to check that rules or standards are followed.
負責檢查規定或標準是否被遵守的人。
ex: A health inspector visited the restaurant yesterday.
一位衛生稽查員昨天造訪了這家餐廳。
The quality inspector approved the batch for shipping.
品管檢驗員核准這批貨出貨。
The building inspector will arrive at nine to review the wiring.
建築檢查員九點會到，檢查電線配置。
Customs inspectors opened the crates at the border.
海關人員在邊境打開了木箱檢查。
A fire inspector checked the exits and the sprinkler system.
消防檢查員檢查了緊急出口和灑水系統。

note: Checks financial accounts, while an inspector checks places, products or procedures.
查核財務帳目；inspector 則檢查場所、產品或程序。
Someone who tests or marks, such as in exams or patent offices.
負責測驗或評分的人，如考試或專利局。
An investigator looks into a possible crime or problem after it happens; an inspector checks routinely.
investigator 在事後調查可能的犯罪或問題；inspector 做例行檢查。

def: The act of putting equipment or software in place so it is ready to use.
把設備或軟體裝設好、使其可供使用的過程。
ex: The installation of the new software takes about thirty minutes.
新軟體的安裝大約要三十分鐘。
We offer free installation with every washing machine.
每台洗衣機我們都提供免費安裝。
The installation of solar panels will start next week.
太陽能板的安裝將在下週開始。
The art installation in the lobby attracts many visitors.
大廳裡的裝置藝術吸引了許多訪客。
Please read the installation guide before you begin.
開始前請先閱讀安裝指南。

note: Less formal; also includes adjusting settings after the equipment is in place.
較不正式；也包括設備裝好後的設定調整。
An instalment (installment in US spelling) is one part of a payment made over time.
instalment（美式拼法 installment）是分期付款中的一期款項。

def: A student or new graduate who works for a short time to gain experience.
為累積經驗而短期工作的學生或新鮮人。
ex: The intern helped prepare slides for the sales meeting.
實習生協助準備了業務會議的投影片。
She interned at an advertising agency last summer.
她去年夏天在一家廣告公司實習。
We are hiring two summer interns for the marketing department.
我們要為行銷部門聘請兩名暑期實習生。
Every intern is assigned a mentor from the team.
每位實習生都會被分配一位團隊中的導師。
He interned at the bank while finishing his degree.
他在完成學位的同時，也在銀行實習。

note: Anyone learning a job through training, not only students.
任何透過訓練學習工作的人，不限於學生。
An apprentice learns a skilled trade over a long period, often for years.
apprentice 在較長時間（常為數年）內學習一門專門技藝。

def: The goods a business has in stock, or a list of them.
企業手上持有的存貨，或其清單。
ex: We take inventory on the last day of every month.
我們每個月最後一天盤點庫存。
The shop's inventory is low after the holiday rush.
假期的搶購潮過後，這家店的庫存偏低。
Our inventory includes over ten thousand different parts.
我們的庫存包含一萬多種不同的零件。
The manager asked staff to update the inventory list.
經理要求員工更新庫存清單。
Excess inventory ties up money that the company could use elsewhere.
過剩的存貨會綁住公司本可用在別處的資金。

note: The goods a shop has on hand; plainer than inventory, which is the business and accounting term and can also mean a list.
店裡現有的貨品；比 inventory 平實，inventory 是商業與會計用語，也可指清單。
An invention is something newly created; an inventory is a list of goods held.
invention 是新創造出的東西；inventory 是持有貨品的清單。

def: A document that lists goods or services and asks for payment.
列出商品或服務並要求付款的文件。
ex: Please send the invoice to our accounts department by email.
請把發票用電子郵件寄給我們的會計部。
The supplier invoiced us for the extra parts.
供應商就額外的零件向我們開了請款單。
Each invoice must show the order number.
每張發票都必須註明訂單編號。
We will invoice the client at the end of the project.
我們會在專案結束時向客戶請款。
The unpaid invoice is now thirty days overdue.
這張未付的請款單已經逾期三十天。

note: Everyday word, often for households; invoice is more formal and used between businesses.
日常用語，常用於一般家庭；invoice 較正式，多用於公司之間。
A receipt shows you have paid; an invoice asks you to pay.
收據證明已付款；invoice 是要求付款。
A quotation states a price before the work; an invoice asks for payment afterwards.
報價單在工作前說明價格；invoice 在事後要求付款。

def: A detailed plan of a journey, listing places and times.
列出地點與時間的詳細旅程計畫。
ex: Our travel agent emailed the itinerary for the conference trip.
旅行社用電子郵件寄來了研討會之行的行程表。
The itinerary includes a stop in Tokyo before the flight to Seoul.
行程中包含在飛往首爾前於東京停留。
Please check the itinerary carefully and tell us about any changes.
請仔細核對行程表，有任何變更請告知我們。
The CEO's itinerary is packed with meetings and site visits.
執行長的行程排滿了會議和現場參訪。
A detailed itinerary was sent to all delegates before arrival.
抵達前，一份詳細行程表已寄給所有代表。

note: A general timetable for any activities; itinerary is only for a journey.
任何活動的時間表；itinerary 僅指旅程。
An agenda lists the topics of a meeting; an itinerary is the plan of a trip.
agenda 列出會議議題；itinerary 是旅行的計畫。

def: Lower in rank or with less experience than others in the same organization.
在同一組織中職階較低或經驗較少。
ex: She is a junior accountant with two years of experience.
她是一名有兩年經驗的資淺會計。
Junior staff are invited to the training session on Friday.
資淺員工受邀參加週五的訓練課程。
He became a junior partner in the law firm last year.
他去年成為律師事務所的資淺合夥人。
The company hired several juniors straight from university.
公司直接從大學聘了幾位資淺新人。
As the most junior member of the team, she takes the meeting notes.
身為團隊中最資淺的成員，她負責做會議紀錄。

note: Describes a job that needs little experience; junior describes rank within a team.
形容不需太多經驗的職位；junior 形容團隊中的職階。
Minor means less important or under the legal age; it does not describe rank.
minor 指較不重要或未成年；不用來描述職階。
